The '''Larrin sector''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The rocky [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Filordis/Legends|Filordis]], [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Filordus]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was situated in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Members of the [[Caarite]] species met with the Filordi on the latter's homeworld in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], inviting them to become partners in the foundation of the [[Metatheran Cartel]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[J'fe Din]] used her popular melodramatic series [[Starflash (holovid series)|''Starflash'']] to covertly transmit vital information to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents in the Larrin sector, hastening the downfall of the Imperial rule there.

==Description==
The Larrin [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="Northern" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the [[Filordis system/Legends|Filordis system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
While the Larrin sector was under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the popular melodramatic [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] series [[Starflash (holovid series)|''Starflash'']] ran there for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The series established the position of its lead [[Actor/Legends|performer]], [[J'fe Din]], at the top of the Larrin sector's vid charts, making her the most popular vidstar in the sector. Unknown to the Larrin sector's Imperial authorities or the show's billions of fans, Din and her [[Unidentified producer|producer]] used the series to surreptitiously convey vital information, such as codes, passwords, and messages, to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents operating in the sector.<ref name="Heroes" />

''Starflash'' ended its run when the Empire's rule was defeated in the Larrin sector, with Din's efforts having hastened the regime's collapse in the sector by at least a year. Din subsequently revealed her true support for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="Heroes" /> which succeeded the Alliance following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|beginning]] of the Empire's fragmentation in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The holovid [[Gender/Legends|actress]] later starred in ''[[Imperial Truth]]'',<ref name="Heroes" /> a docudrama series produced in the Larrin sector<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|97|''Imperial Truth''}}</ref> that dramatized the realities of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial reign]]. Din's continued open promotion of the New Republic greatly improved that government's standings in the Larrin sector.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Locations==
The Larrin sector's Filordis [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> was home to the rocky [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Filordis/Legends|Filordis]].<ref name="UAA" /> The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Filordis was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], and Filordis constituted a part of the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] took place in [[3996 BBY]]. Around that time, a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA Filordis" /> passing through the sector<ref name="Hyperlane">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the [[Filordis system/Legends|Filordis system]] on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] by [[3996 BBY]]. Since {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the Larrin [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route must have also passed through the sector at that [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> connected Filordis to the [[Nouane system/Legends|Nouane]] and [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn systems]]; however, that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route had ceased to exist by the time the [[Mandalorian Wars]] were fought [[3976 BBY|twenty years]] later.<ref name="TEA Filordis" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="32 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' establishes that the [[Metatheran Cartel]] was founded one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Filordus|Filordi]], the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] natives of Filordis, met with members of the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the former's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The Caarites invited the Filordi to become partners in a new business venture, the [[Metatheran Cartel]], to which the Filordi agreed.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Larrin sector was first mentioned in the [[1995]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]].<ref name="Heroes" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Filordis system in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA Filordis" />
